operators.name: conv3d_forward
semantics: Performs 3D convolution with cuDNN using input, weight, optional bias, stride, padding, dilation as configured in nn.Conv3d.
Input shape [N, C_in, D, H, W], weight [C_out, C_in, kD, kH, kW], bias [C_out] if present.
Output shape computed using standard Conv3d formula: D_out = floor((D + 2*padding[0] - dilation[0]*(kD-1) - 1)/stride[0] + 1), similarly for H, W.
If bias is None, no bias is added.
Uses cuDNN convolution, supports non-contiguous input (strides).
Returns Tensor of dtype float32 on CUDA.

operators.name: softplus_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise softplus: y = log(1 + exp(x)) with threshold for numerical stability as per torch.nn.functional.softplus.
Applies to each element independently, preserves shape, dtype float32, device CUDA.
Returns Tensor of dtype float32 on CUDA.
First computes conv3d(x) with conv3d module (bias=True, stride=(1,1,1), padding=(0,0,0), dilation=(1,1,1)), then applies F.softplus element-wise.
Output is a float32 tensor on CUDA with shape [2,2,510,30,30].
